The '''Ychthyton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ychthytonian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TNR" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ychthyton system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square R-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
